business_definition: Stable hospital key for RCM filters (H1-H5, ALL) and future profitability joins
transformation_logic: Map site code to hospital_id; ALL = exact sum of H1-H5 ledgers
data_quality_rule: Must be in demo site set {H1..H5, ALL}; ALL recomputes rates from summed numerators/denominators

business_definition: Clinical/supporting department for charge capture and missed-charge attribution (supporting finance view only)
transformation_logic: Normalize to RCM department list (8 departments)
data_quality_rule: Known department or mapped; clinical KPI ownership stays in Domains 1-10
missing_data_behavior: Hospital-only aggregates; omit department chart grain

business_definition: Finance service-line rollup used for missed-charge attribution (7 service lines)
data_quality_rule: Exactly one service line per department per period; split values sum to total

business_definition: Parent care episode for eligibility, authorization, charge, invoice and claim joins
transformation_logic: Direct; one encounter may have multiple payers (multi-payer encounters)
data_quality_rule: Unique; no real identifiers in demo
missing_data_behavior: Retain aggregate counts; block encounter-level drill-through

business_definition: Non-identifying patient key; MRN, national ID and contact data are never stored in the demo
data_quality_rule: Reject identifiable values; no real PHI

business_definition: Reporting bucket (year / Qn) used for flows; stocks use period-end observation date
transformation_logic: Derive from event timestamps; quarters slice the same monthly ledger as the year
data_quality_rule: Quarter flows sum to year; opening AR of Qn+1 = closing AR of Qn

business_definition: Currency of all monetary fields; demo label SAR (RCM_CURRENCY). Configurable per market; no FX conversion is invented
transformation_logic: Direct from configuration; amounts stored in minor-unit-free numeric
data_quality_rule: Single currency per hospital-period; mixed currency blocks aggregation
missing_data_behavior: Fail closed: do not aggregate monetary KPIs across currencies

business_definition: Payer / responsible-party key. Demo payers are fictional (5); one is patient self-pay
transformation_logic: Normalize payer master; patient responsibility modeled as a distinct payer
data_quality_rule: Known payer; AR by payer sums to closing AR
missing_data_behavior: Group as Unassigned payer; flag payer-level KPIs thin

business_definition: Display name for payer charts (fictional demo names, never real payers)
data_quality_rule: Max display length fits chart axis

business_definition: Benefit plan under a payer; needed for plan-level contract rates and exclusions
data_quality_rule: Plan belongs to exactly one payer

business_definition: Tokenized policy / member reference. Real policy numbers are never exposed
data_quality_rule: Never store raw policy number; token only
missing_data_behavior: Eligibility KPIs remain count-based; no policy drill-through

business_definition: Start of coverage validity used to judge inactive-policy exceptions on the service date
data_quality_rule: effective_from <= effective_to; service within window or flagged as exception

business_definition: Payer contract governing allowed amounts (contract structure is market-specific and configurable)
transformation_logic: Effective-dated join to claim_line by payer, plan, service, date
data_quality_rule: Exactly one effective contract per claim line
missing_data_behavior: Underpayment value cannot be derived from contract; stay Partially Mapped

business_definition: Identifier of an eligibility verification request tied to an encounter
data_quality_rule: Unique; one required check per eligible encounter

business_definition: Time the check was requested (cohort entry)
Outcome: verified / exception (inactive, not covered) / not completed
transformation_logic: Map payer-specific statuses to {VERIFIED, EXCEPTION, NOT_COMPLETED}
missing_data_behavior: Cohort denominator retained; status unknown counts as not completed

business_definition: Time a completed eligibility response was received
Identifier of an authorization request for planned/ordered services
data_quality_rule: Unique; opening pending + requested = decided + closing pending

business_definition: Request time; starts turnaround clock
PENDING / APPROVED / REJECTED (requests that expired or were not requested are handled as exceptions, not approvals)
transformation_logic: Map payer statuses to {PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED}

business_definition: Decision time for approved/rejected requests; null while pending
missing_data_behavior: Request stays pending; excluded from turnaround

business_definition: Why a request was slow (documentation, payer response, clinical review queue); administrative only
Delivered chargeable service identifier (catalog item)
missing_data_behavior: Aggregate chargeable counts by department only

business_definition: Procedure/service code from the market's coding standard (standard and version recorded separately)
transformation_logic: Map to canonical procedure_id; keep source code set and version
data_quality_rule: Code belongs to declared code set + version

business_definition: Time the service was delivered; anchors charge-capture eligibility and revenue recognition
True when the service is eligible to be charged (excludes nonbillable, bundled, cancelled)
transformation_logic: Derive from charge master + bundling + cancellation status
data_quality_rule: Only billable services enter the charge-capture denominator
missing_data_behavior: Treat as not billable; do not inflate missed charges

business_definition: Stable identifier of a captured charge (charges are not revenue and not cash)
missing_data_behavior: Count captured services from aggregate only

business_definition: Gross charge in currency_code before contractual allowance (gross != net != cash)
transformation_logic: Direct; gross charges - contractual allowances = net patient revenue

business_definition: POSTED / HELD / REVERSED / CANCELLED; only posted billable charges count as captured
Time the charge was posted; starts charge-to-bill lag
Eligible billable service without a captured charge; not every unmatched clinical event is missed
transformation_logic: Derived: service_billable_flag = true AND no posted charge by lag target
data_quality_rule: Must meet billable eligibility; human review before posting

business_definition: Expected net (post-allowance) value used to value unbilled and missed services; not gross charges as cash
transformation_logic: Gross x (1 - expected allowance rate by payer/contract)
data_quality_rule: <= gross charge; uses contract when available

business_definition: READY / COMPLETE / HELD; coding completion = complete / ready
Coding completion time (operational completion, not an accuracy audit)
Invoice created for an encounter; claims relate to invoices (one invoice -> one or more claims)
data_quality_rule: Unique; unbilled = completed eligible encounter without invoice

business_definition: Invoice creation date; ends charge-to-bill lag and starts aging of unbilled WIP
Invoice total (gross billed); not revenue until net of contractual allowance
data_quality_rule: Equals sum of invoice charge lines

business_definition: Open billing exception (missing data, code edit, hold) on an invoice
Illustrative exception reason split on the Billing screen (not a verified payer edit list)
Unique claim identity. Unique claims != submission attempts; resubmissions reuse claim_id
data_quality_rule: Unique per claim; count distinct for unique-claim KPIs

business_definition: Line within a claim; outcomes may be mixed (paid + denied) and amounts roll up to claim
data_quality_rule: Sum of line billed/allowed/denied/paid = claim totals
missing_data_behavior: Value denial at claim level only; flag claim-line grain missing

business_definition: One transmission attempt of a claim (initial, corrected, resubmission); count != unique claims
1 = first submission (first-pass cohort); >1 = resubmission
transformation_logic: Window count per claim_id by submitted_at

business_definition: Submission timestamp; also the aging clock for AR (aging clock = claim submission date)
Draft -> Validated -> Submitted -> Acknowledged -> Adjudicated -> Paid / Partially Paid / Denied; plus Corrected, Resubmitted, Reversed
transformation_logic: Event-sourced; keep full state history with timestamps
data_quality_rule: Valid transitions only; terminal states explicit

business_definition: Technical rejection at clearinghouse/scrubber before payer adjudication (clearinghouse reject != payer denial)
data_quality_rule: Rejects never counted as denials; first-pass accepted + rejects = unique claims

business_definition: Technical reject reason (format / scrubber edit); not a payer denial code
transformation_logic: Map to internal taxonomy; keep raw value

business_definition: Amount billed to the payer on the line (gross)
Payer adjudication time; adjudicated cohort = denominator for denial rates
missing_data_behavior: Claim stays in submitted cohort; excluded from denial denominator

business_definition: Payer-allowed amount on the line; allowed - paid on underpaid lines = underpayment
Amount denied on a claim line (claim may have mixed outcomes)
data_quality_rule: <= billed/adjudicated amount; denied claim count uses unique claims

business_definition: DataVital internal denial category code (9 categories, e.g. DENY_AUTH_MISSING). Raw payer/standard codes are kept separately; no payer-specific code set is invented
transformation_logic: Crosswalk raw denial_source_code -> internal category via configurable market table
data_quality_rule: Every denied line maps to exactly one category
missing_data_behavior: Group as Unclassified; flag mapping gap

business_definition: Raw payer or standards-based denial code exactly as received (source and version recorded)
Code set and version for denial_source_code (e.g. payer-published list, X12 code list); never assumed globally
Possible contributing factor (distinct from observed reason). Human-assessed; AI does not alter submitted claims
Evidence missing for appeal (documents, authorization proof)
Assessed recoverability (RECOVERABLE / PARTIAL / NOT_RECOVERABLE). Demo uses 40-50% of denied value as an illustrative assessment; not collected cash
missing_data_behavior: Recoverable value unavailable; show denied value only

business_definition: Appeal against a denied claim line/claim
data_quality_rule: Unique; linked to a denied claim

business_definition: PENDING / WON / PARTIAL / LOST; success rate counts decided appeals only
Appeal decision time
Cash receipt event (payer or patient). Reversals and credits tracked as separate events
Remittance advice grouping payments and claim-level adjustments from a payer
Cash/remittance receipt time (cash received != cash applied)
Time cash was applied to encounter/claim AR. Null = unapplied; unmatched receipts must not reduce encounter AR
Cash applied to AR for a line/claim (flow, summed across months). Net collection rate uses applied cash
Cash received on the remittance (>= applied; difference = unapplied cash)
Cash received - cash applied for the period; YTD stock reported separately; never negative
Why a remittance is not applied (no match, duplicate, short-pay, missing remit)
Days from claim submission to first payment application for paid claims
Stable identifier for an AR adjustment (contractual, administrative, correction, transfer)
data_quality_rule: Unique; approved adjustments only reduce AR

business_definition: CONTRACTUAL_ALLOWANCE / APPROVED_ADJUSTMENT / CORRECTION / TRANSFER. Contractual allowances are never leakage
transformation_logic: Map to enum; separate from write-offs

business_definition: Signed adjustment amount (consistent sign convention: reductions to AR positive in ledger flow)
transformation_logic: Apply sign convention once at load

business_definition: Only approved adjustments enter the AR roll-forward; human approval required
data_quality_rule: Approval timestamp and approver pseudonym required

business_definition: Approved write-off record (no automatic write-offs; AI cannot write off balances)
Classification: AVOIDABLE (preventable) vs CONTRACTUAL vs BAD_DEBT (nonrecoverable). Only avoidable counts toward leakage
data_quality_rule: Contractual and bad debt excluded from avoidable write-offs
missing_data_behavior: Avoidable write-offs unavailable; do not infer

business_definition: Approved write-off amount
Period-end AR snapshot (opening + new - cash applied - approved adjustments - write-offs +/- corrections = closing). Never summed across months
transformation_logic: Snapshot as of period end; year = Dec balance
data_quality_rule: Roll-forward residual = 0; split by payer/aging sums to closing AR
missing_data_behavior: Block AR / Days in AR KPIs

business_definition: Opening AR of the period = prior period closing AR
New receivables added when billed (net of contractual allowance); unbilled WIP is excluded
transformation_logic: Net revenue - change in unbilled WIP
data_quality_rule: net revenue = new receivables + change in WIP

business_definition: Aging bucket on claim submission date: 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91-120, >120
INSURER vs PATIENT responsibility; insurer AR + patient AR = closing AR
data_quality_rule: Exactly one type per balance line
demo_representation: Aggregate ledger measure (patient share is a demo share of closing AR)

business_definition: Revenue recognition event (prevents double counting when recoveries are later paid)
Date net revenue is recognized (demo convention: net of contractual allowance in the billing month; recognition != cash)
data_quality_rule: Recognized once; denial recovery not double-counted

business_definition: Hook for future Healthcare Resource, Profitability & Expansion domain. Not used by Domain 12 screens
Exclusive driver: MISSED_CHARGE / AVOIDABLE_WRITEOFF / UNDERPAYMENT. Exactly one per item (no double counting)
transformation_logic: Assign by priority rule; contractual allowances never assigned

business_definition: CONFIRMED vs POTENTIAL; potential exposure is not additive to confirmed leakage
Open recovery work item with exclusive financial attribution (work items are not recovered amounts)
One of eight what-if opportunity IDs (rcm-denials-down ... rcm-workflow-up). Scenarios overlap and are not additive
Illustrative eligible value under documented assumption (not realized cash)
Responsible team for a recommended action (human approval required)
Market profile controlling currency, payer rules, claim formats, coding standards and workflows (no country rule hardcoded in KPI logic)
Potential claim exchange format: NPHIES / HL7 FHIR financial resources (Saudi, potential), X12 837/835 (US), local formats. Not certified and not implemented
Coding standard and version in effect (not assumed globally)
Tax treatment profile (market-specific; none applied in demo)
Payment model (fee-for-service, bundled, capitation) - affects allowed amount logic; demo is fee-for-service style
Hook for future profitability domain only; unused in Domain 12
